summary: Ionis filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing a press release with partner Roche reporting positive prespecified interim Phase 3 IMAgINATION results for sefaxersen in adults with primary IgA nephropathy. The study met its primary endpoint, showing statistically significant and clinically meaningful proteinuria reduction versus placebo at 37 weeks by 24-hour UPCR, with safety consistent with prior data and no new signals. The trial continues blinded to week 105 eGFR. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated; sefaxersen remains partnered with Roche.
